# Bubble Invest — Full Company & Services Description

> Bubble Invest is a dual-activity company based in France: free B2C educational content on AI agents and investment automation, plus B2B AI automation consulting for finance professionals and SMEs. Founded by ex-Deloitte and UBS professionals.

## Company Overview

Bubble Invest operates two complementary activities:

### B2C — Free Content & Education (Marketing)
Our consumer-facing activity is entirely free. We share our investment agent proof of concept openly, along with tutorials, demos, and resources on AI agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, etc.). We publish a free newsletter on Substack and maintain a bilingual blog (French/English) covering AI automation, investment technology, and agent architectures. The B2C activity proves our expertise and feeds our B2B pipeline.

### B2B — Custom AI Automation Consulting (Revenue)
We help professionals deploy cutting-edge AI agents and automation. Our unique edge: systematic early adoption — we master tools weeks after release, well ahead of the market.

## Detailed Service Offerings

### Quick Start Pack — 2,000 EUR HT
Our flagship offering. Three sessions over approximately three weeks:

**Session 1 — Diagnostic & Preparation (1-2h, video call)**
We understand your workflow and identify 2-3 quick wins with high ROI. We prepare agents upstream before coming on-site.

**Session 2 — Installation & Hands-on (2-3h, on-site)**
We install Claude Code or OpenClaw on your machine. Live demo on your real documents. You leave operational.

**Session 3 — Follow-up & Adjustments (1-2h, video call, 1-2 weeks later)**
Feedback on real usage, agent adjustments, advanced tips. Final documentation for 100% autonomy.

**What You Leave With:**
- Claude Code or OpenClaw installed and functional
- 2-3 operational agents adapted to your profession
- Custom documentation "Agents for [your profession]" with your concrete use cases
- Simple roadmap: 3 actions for tomorrow
- Best practices checklist

### Complementary Services
- Follow-up / Debug Sessions: 150 EUR HT/h
- Monthly Maintenance: 500 EUR HT/month (ongoing support, agent updates, new tool integration)
- Custom Complex Agent Development: on quote (multi-agent SaaS, API integrations, etc.)

## Target Clients

### Finance Professionals
- **Wealth Advisors (CGP)**: Automated reporting, client communication, regulatory watch
- **Asset Management Firms**: Market intelligence, research automation, risk monitoring
- **Financial Analysts**: Source scanning, draft generation, data extraction

### Small & Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
- **Tech SMEs**: Business development automation, prospecting, CRM integration
- **Digital Agencies**: Social media orchestration, content generation, client deliverables
- **Consulting Firms**: Knowledge management, proposal automation, competitive intelligence

### Regulated Professions
- **Architects**: Regulatory watch by project and location, compliance monitoring
- **Legal Firms**: Document analysis, contract review assistance, case research
- **Accountants**: Report automation, data extraction, client communication

## Concrete Use Cases Deployed

### 1. Market Intelligence & Automated Reporting
**Client**: Asset management firm
**Solution**: 2 interconnected agents scanning 50+ sources and calculating metrics in real time
**Results**: 3 hours saved every morning, instant reporting, +40% risk detection

### 2. Regulatory Watch
**Client**: Architecture firm
**Solution**: Agent scanning regulatory updates by project and location, contextual alerts
**Results**: Zero compliance delays, watch effort divided by 5, total coverage

### 3. Research & Automated Drafting
**Client**: Financial analysis team
**Solution**: Agent reading 200+ sources/day, extracting key points, generating structured draft notes
**Results**: -70% drafting time, 100% source coverage, focus shifted to qualitative analysis

### 4. Social Media Multi-Agent Team
**Client**: Digital agency
**Solution**: 5 orchestrated sub-agents covering LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X, and Substack
**Results**: 5 platforms automated, content creation time divided by 4, real-time trend detection

### 5. Business Development Automation
**Client**: Tech SME
**Solution**: Agent scanning LinkedIn + tender platforms, qualifying prospects, generating personalized messages
**Results**: +200% leads, prospecting effort divided by 5, personalized outreach at scale

## Our Differentiation

### Triple Expertise (Rare Combination)
- **Finance**: Native understanding of regulatory issues, risk management, and industry workflows (ex-Deloitte, ex-UBS)
- **Technology**: Full-stack skills, up-to-date stack, cloud-native architectures
- **AI**: Operational mastery of the latest models, continuous technology watch

### Philosophy
- **No vendor lock-in**: We document everything — code, prompts, processes. From day one, you can take over. Our success is when you no longer need us.
- **Honest pricing**: No six-figure consulting engagements that lead nowhere. Clear, transparent pricing.
- **Early adopter advantage**: We systematically master tools weeks after their release, placing our clients well ahead of their competitors.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: We don't have an internal tech team. Does it still work?**
A: Yes — that's exactly why we exist. We come from the business side (Deloitte, UBS), not pure development. We speak your language and train your teams while we build. No technical prerequisites required.

**Q: How long does it take?**
A: 3 sessions over about 3 weeks. Diagnostic, on-site installation, then follow-up and adjustments. You're operational by session 2.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: Standard pack: 2,000 EUR excl. tax (3 sessions, 5-7h effective work). Additionally: Claude Pro subscription ~20 EUR/month (or free OpenClaw). Follow-up: 150 EUR/h. Maintenance: 500 EUR/month.

**Q: What if we want to stop working with you?**
A: That's the goal! We document everything — code, prompts, processes. From day one, you can take over. Our success is when you no longer need us.

- Workflow automation pipelines
